Sourav Ganguly Inducted into ICC Hall of Fame on Birthday

Former Indian cricket captain Sourav Ganguly has been inducted into the ICC Hall of Fame. The announcement coincided with his 54th birthday, which he received as a significant gift. The induction recognizes his contributions to cricket.
